hero.title: One company, four pillars, a single standard.
hero.intro: Glob3x Group is a family of companies that develop, build, equip and operate buildings. Each project on this website states exactly which role the company played.

manifesto.title: Builders first.
body: Glob3x Group started on site, not in a sales office. Founded in 2008, the company began building multi-storey residential buildings in Tirana, acting as developer and general contractor at the same time. That double role still defines it: the company sells what it builds, and builds what it sells.

In 2014 Glob3x Construction took more than 820 Albanian workers to Russia for the Sochi Winter Olympics construction programme: the Sochi railway station, the Krasnaya Polyana tourist village and the auxiliary buildings of the Adler stadium. In 2019 more than 500 professionals completed the company's phase of Skopje East Gate, a 44,000 m² shopping centre in North Macedonia.

Today Glob3x Group has three residential buildings completed in Tirana, Lorden Residence under construction and on sale, a luxury hotel in Pezë and three villas in Drymades in development, and three towers in design, led by Reeds Towers, one of the tallest projects ever designed in Albania.

reeds-towers.name: Reeds Towers
reeds-towers.tagline: Where the vision touches the sky.
reeds-towers.intro: Two towers of 55 and 36 floors above ground rising 191.89 m above Kavaja Street, over five underground levels of more than 2,500 m² each.
body: Reeds Towers brings together, in 83,576 m² of gross floor area, a business hub of about 996 m² per floor on the ground and first two levels, hotel floors 3 to 5 of about 1,000 m² each, residences from floor 6 to 47 and a panoramic restaurant on floors 48 to 54 with 360° views over Tirana, Dajti mountain and the Adriatic.

The towers are composed of vertical cylindrical elements clad in white terrazzo and structural glazing. Residential units range from 1+1 apartments of about 57 m² to 2+1 apartments of about 101 m², each with a curved glazed façade segment and a loggia.
Glob3x Group develops and builds the project. Reeds Towers has its own sales team and a dedicated website with the full brochure, floor plans, prices and film.

glow-tower.name: Glow Tower
glow-tower.kicker: Zenel Bastari Street · New Boulevard · Tirana
glow-tower.tagline: A 95.50 m mixed-use tower on the New Boulevard.
glow-tower.intro: A 25-storey tower with six underground levels and 28,963 m² of gross floor area on Zenel Bastari Street, in the New Boulevard area: residential, hotel, commercial and service functions stacked in a single slender volume.
body: Glow Tower rises 95.50 m above the New Boulevard, the axis that is becoming Tirana's new business district. Twenty-five floors above ground combine residences, commercial and service spaces, with six underground levels for parking and technical plant.
The hotel occupies the upper floors: rooms on levels 22 and 23, and on levels 24 and 25 a double-height space with pool, salt-therapy and massage rooms, opening onto the city and the mountains.

urban-millefeuille.name: Urban Millefeuille
urban-millefeuille.tagline: Slender vertical structures with elevated gardens.
urban-millefeuille.intro: A mixed-use development of 67,082.70 m² gross floor area on a 10,542 m² plot on Siri Kodra Street: slender vertical structures of up to 95 m, layered like a millefeuille, with multi-level elevated gardens.
body: Urban Millefeuille breaks the mass of a large urban block into slender vertical structures. Between them, elevated gardens on several levels bring planting, light and outdoor space to every band of the building, from the street to the roof.

The plot sits 3 minutes from the New Boulevard, 6 minutes from the city centre and 20 minutes from Tirana International Airport. Residences, offices and retail share the ground level with public passages through the block.

lorden-residence.name: Lorden Residence
lorden-residence.tagline: Eighty homes around an inner park, 1.6 km from Skanderbeg Square.
lorden-residence.intro: A seven-storey residential building with two underground levels and 11,064.54 m² of gross floor area on Ramazan Bogdani Street, developed and built by Glob3x Group. Apartments now selling directly from the developer.
body: Lorden Residence comprises 80 apartments, about 1,300 m² of commercial space and 100 parking spaces on two underground levels. The building is 300 m from the New Boulevard and 1.6 km from Skanderbeg Square, with direct connections to the centre of Tirana.

Surrounded by streets on all sides and organised around an internal park, the residence combines thermal and acoustic insulation, modern mechanical systems and recreational space for residents. Typical unit plans are published below; the sales team sends the complete price list on request.

new-corner-residence.name: New Corner Residence
new-corner-residence.tagline: A completed residence in the New Boulevard master-plan zone.
new-corner-residence.intro: A completed residential and commercial building of 6 and 7 floors with two underground parking levels and 5,908 m² of gross floor area on Besa Street, in the development zone beside the New Boulevard. A ground-floor commercial unit of 77.5 m² is for sale.
body: New Corner Residence was built in one of the most important development areas of Tirana, the master-planned district beside the New Boulevard. Six and seven residential floors with ground-floor services define modern living in the heart of the city.

Two levels of underground parking, an integrated recreational space and finished common areas complete the building. Available now: a ground-floor commercial unit of 77.5 m² with east–west orientation.

avi-residence-boulevard.name: Avi Residence Boulevard
avi-residence-boulevard.intro: A completed residential and commercial building of 8 and 9 floors with one underground level and 7,220.40 m² of gross floor area on Jordan Misja Street, next to the New Boulevard.
body: Avi Residence Boulevard combines a ventilated façade with thermal and acoustic insulation, commercial spaces at street level and recreational areas for residents. The address, beside the New Boulevard, places it in one of the best-connected parts of the capital.
Plans for apartments 6, 37, 41 and 43 are shown below; the sales agents send availability and the complete price list on request.

art-residence.name: Art Residence
art-residence.tagline: Completed on Ali Demi, 2,844.77 m² of homes and services.
art-residence.intro: A completed residential and services building of 4, 6 and 7 floors with two underground levels and 2,844.77 m² of gross floor area on Ali Demi Street, developed and built by Glob3x Group.
body: Art Residence steps from four to seven floors along Ali Demi Street, one of Tirana's established residential neighbourhoods, with two underground levels and ground-floor services.
The building is completed and handed over. Its finished lobby and common areas set the standard the company now applies to Lorden Residence.

luxury-villas-drymades.name: Luxury Villas Drymades
luxury-villas-drymades.tagline: Three villas above the Ionian Sea.
luxury-villas-drymades.intro: Three seaside villas on two to three levels with a shared underground level in Drymades, on the Albanian Riviera. Stone, timber and glass, with every main room oriented towards the Ionian Sea.
body: The villas sit on a plot between the beach and the Ceraunian mountains, a few steps from the sea. Each villa has two to three above-ground floors; a common underground level holds parking and technical rooms, shown in the drawings below.

The site plan and the floor plans of each villa are published: ground floor, first floor and second floor, with the parking level. The project is in development; the drone footage above shows the plot and its coastline.

luxury-hotel-peze.name: Luxury Hotel Pezë
luxury-hotel-peze.tagline: A luxury hotel in the landscape of Pezë.
luxury-hotel-peze.intro: A low, two-storey hotel with one underground level in Pezë, about 12 km south-west of Tirana: rooms and suites around a courtyard pool, with restaurant and spa, developed and built by Glob3x Group.
body: The hotel is organised as a curved volume around a landscaped courtyard and pool, opening onto the hills of Pezë. Rooms and suites face the garden; the restaurant and spa occupy the ground floor with direct access to the terraces.
The experience gained on this project feeds directly into the hotel floors and panoramic restaurant of Reeds Towers.

skopje-east-gate.name: Skopje East Gate
skopje-east-gate.tagline: A 44,000 m² shopping centre, delivered with 500+ professionals.
skopje-east-gate.intro: In 2019 Glob3x Construction executed its phase of East Gate in Skopje, a 44,000 m² shopping centre and one of the largest retail-led developments in North Macedonia, mobilising more than 500 professionals.
body: On the East Gate site, Glob3x crews worked on the reinforced-concrete structure of the complex alongside tower cranes and concrete-pumping fleets, applying the site organisation first proven on the Sochi programme.
The company delivered its phase of the project to completion, confirming its ability to mobilise large teams across borders and to work inside the programmes of major regional developers.

sochi-2014.name: Sochi 2014
sochi-2014.tagline: 820 workers, six site types, one Olympic deadline.
sochi-2014.intro: In 2014 Glob3x Construction took part in the construction programme of the Sochi Winter Olympics with more than 820 workers from Albania.
body: The Olympic programme was the company's first large international mobilisation. Albanian crews worked on the Sochi railway station, the Krasnaya Polyana tourist village, the auxiliary buildings of the Adler stadium, tourist complexes and social and cultural buildings.
Delivering on the Olympic calendar, with its fixed opening date, shaped the way Glob3x Group plans and runs every site since.

concept.title: From the ground to the crown.
paragraphs: The base. The towers occupy a building footprint of 1,786.45 m², or 35.37% of the 5,050.7 m² plot. The remaining 64.63% is given to a public plaza, streets and planting, with retail and cafés at level ±0.00 opening onto Kavaja Street.

The shaft. Each tower is a cluster of vertical cylinders clad in white terrazzo and glass. Dividing the volume turns a height of 191.89 m into a slender silhouette and gives every residential unit a curved façade segment with a loggia. Technical floors 15 and 34 punctuate the shaft of Tower A.

The crown. At the top, the floor plate reduces over seven stepped levels from 630 m² to 41 m², up to level +188.10 m. Each level has its own planted terrace, oriented towards Dajti mountain, the city or the Adriatic.

facade.title: Double-skin façade: terrazzo and structural glazing.
facade.body: Two layers: white ceramic terrazzo cladding and floor-to-ceiling structural glazing. Tall vertical openings bring daylight deep into the plan, while the cylindrical geometry shades the glass through the day.

landscape.title: Continuous planting, from the plaza to the crown.
landscape.body: A continuous planting system runs from the public plaza to the crown terraces: native Mediterranean species, shaded areas, water features and white metal pergolas.

section.title: The programme, floor by floor.
section.body: Both towers are drawn at the same scale. The width of each floor is proportional to its area.
section.hint: Hover or tap a floor or a function.

features.title: Hotel
features.body: Floors 3 – 5 of Tower A, with double rooms and suites. A dedicated 120 m² lobby on floor 0 and separate hotel lifts.

features.title: Panoramic restaurant
features.body: A seven-level crown on Tower A and a six-level crown on Tower B. Every level has an outdoor terrace with a different orientation over the city.

features.title: Wellness
features.body: Infinity pool, spa and lounge areas, designed as part of the residents' services programme.

features.title: Offices & retail
features.body: Tower A: 2 office floors of 996 m² each. Tower B: 3 office floors of 790 m². Retail and cafés on floor 0 with direct access from the plaza.

residences.title: Residential units with curved façades and panoramic views.
residences.body: The plan, built on cylindrical elements, gives every unit a curved glazed façade segment and a loggia. The typical floor of Tower A carries 10 units around a central vertical-circulation core.
amenities: Panoramic restaurant and lounge in the crown

pricing.title: From €3,800 / m². 30% on reservation, 70% in ten six-monthly instalments.
pricing.body: Prices apply to residential units in both towers and are calculated on the unit area: €3,800 / m² up to floor 12, €4,200 / m² on floors 13 – 30, on request above floor 30. The dedicated website carries the full price list and a payment calculator.

location.title: Kavaja Street, Tirana.
location.body: The 5,050.7 m² plot sits on Rruga e Kavajës, the western axis of the capital, within walking distance of Skanderbeg Square, the Grand Park and the business district.

why.title: Strategic location
why.body: 20 minutes from Tirana International Airport, 40 minutes from the Adriatic coast at Durrës, on the main axis between the centre and the new ring road.

why.title: A growing economy
why.body: Albania is an EU candidate with steady GDP growth and record tourism years. Tirana's residential market still trades below Mediterranean capitals.

why.title: Mediterranean climate
why.body: Over 2,500 hours of sun a year, mild winters and Dajti mountain 15 minutes away.
